verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss is a CRM, so auto-enriching contact and company records is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any enrichment capability, either firmographic or contact-level. The REST API, custom fields and lead-source integrations are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not enrichment itself.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have contact and company records auto-enriched with firmographic and contact data
